rule: A gate is complete only when its implementation and required behavioral evidence exist. Contract fixtures do not count as live provider, real inference or physical-device acceptance. Statuses distinguish verified scope from remaining external or platform acceptance.

gates.requirement: Integrate HarmonyOS handoff without losing saved login or composer fixes
gates.evidence: Historical Harmony handoff baseline; it does not establish current Harmony SDK or device acceptance. Current scoped Harmony contract evidence is recorded by harmony-account-lifecycle in work-progress.json.

gates.requirement: Typed Computer API, one hub attachment, lifecycle and reconnect independence
gates.evidence: tests/domain.test.ts and tests/transport.test.ts

gates.requirement: Single owners, separate invitations, dual membership creation, hub-first retention
gates.evidence: 32 policy combinations plus browser live changes

gates.requirement: Hub-local accounts and identity bindings; optional shared authority only when explicitly configured
gates.evidence: Independent Hub account/database/signing-key ownership is exercised by isolated Hub and browser checks. Explicit linking and provider/PKCE fixtures cover Hub-local identities; the optional shared-authority coordinator remains compatible but is not an independent-Hub dependency. Live provider delivery remains separate.

gates.requirement: Feishu, WeChat, email and phone sign-in on actual integrations
Independent hubs, exact token audience, scoped discovery, fail-closed policy decisions
gates.evidence: Independent Hub processes with separate accounts, databases and signing keys; 5 distributed browser checkpoints; exact audience isolation and fail-closed policy outage tests. Shared-authority compatibility tests are separate from this independent-Hub evidence.

gates.requirement: Owner-bound single-use enrollment and transfer fencing within the configured authority
gates.evidence: Independent-Hub transfer passes17 durable fencing tests and5 actual installed-Pi public-API checks. Source revocation precedes destination admission; journal checkpoints and retry nonces fence lost replies.

gates.requirement: Bounded streaming uploads, binary downloads, ranges, SSE, cancellation and media paths
gates.evidence: Four one-use authenticated download tests and2 real browser checks pass for257MiB+37 bytes with matching SHA-256, mounted application and successful next turn. Physical Safari/device acceptance remains separate.

gates.requirement: Real isolated CLI continues across hub and client loss; terminal sessions import
gates.evidence: Nine installed-CLI browser checks cover Pi/Claude saved resume, Codex/Claude terminal import and interruption, service/tunnel reconnect and untrusted Codex setup. Separate nine exact Computer SIGKILL launch-boundary checks pass across installed Pi, Codex and Claude. Live Kimi/LiteLLM Pi tools, interruption, outage, reconnect and transfer pass; an actual Claude Messages tool call succeeded. Codex Responses streaming succeeds, but native Codex shell-tool execution remains unproven. Broker/queue/Hub mutation fault coverage remains open.

gates.requirement: Files, git, uploads, queues, settings, search, voice and scoped recovery
gates.evidence: Delegated multiple-root/path/Git/upload/transcode acceptance passes5 independent-client Chrome checks. Unified terminal/browser durable queue passes5 installed-Pi browser checks; existing brokers need explicit upgraded resume. One-use browser download evidence is recorded under relay. Accessibility checks cover8 grouped workflows, nine family/mode appearances,18 touch targets/groups and13 font invariants; contrast minima are4.514 light and5.196 dark. Remaining external/browser limits are listed separately. Physical assistive-technology/device and production operational acceptance remain open.

gates.requirement: Explicit direct profile with no automatic fallback and regression coverage
gates.evidence: Harmony ApiClient direct login, no fallback and stale-response behavior pass with mocked OS networking. Native/device acceptance remains tracked separately.

gates.requirement: Computer-owned durable queued prompts reauthorize the actor before dispatch and never replay uncertain sends
gates.evidence: One durable ordered queue serves terminal and browser; five installed-Pi browser checks and39 native tests cover edits, dispatch and persistence. On ambiguous broker death after paste, the durable uncertainty barrier prevents replay. Existing brokers retain their previous safe queue until explicit upgraded resume.

gates.requirement: Unsent remote drafts remain private to their account and Computer attachment
gates.evidence: Computer-owned private SQLite storage, actor-specific catalog timestamps and tombstones; tests cover restart, account/session/attachment isolation and size bounds. Two actual browser accounts sharing one real Pi session cannot read or overwrite each other’s drafts.

gates.requirement: Recover a completed launch after a lost reply without starting a duplicate process
gates.evidence: Computer commits an uncertainty barrier before launch and saves the result by agent and attachment. Read-only receipt lookup survives restart and rejects duplicate launches. Actual browser recovers an existing Pi agent after a simulated lost central result; local process count stays at two. Late failures cannot erase the recovered result. If the Computer never saved a result, explicit owner inspection/import remains necessary.

gates.requirement: Durable completion outbox, deduplication, access checks and provider delivery
gates.evidence: Nine Web Push protocol checks and nine actual Chrome worker checks cover controlled-endpoint encryption, show/click and scope/revocation. Actual vendor delivery, physical OS click, Safari/mobile acceptance remain open.

gates.requirement: Native relay login, context, media, secure credentials, device lifecycle and push
gates.evidence: Self-contained ArkTS SDK scaffold and mocked OS contracts cover login, vault, refresh loss fences, account switching and multi-Hub subscriptions against two real independent Hub APIs. Workspace/native/identity/Harmony suite passes52 tests. No SDK compile, signing, physical build or Push Kit delivery is claimed.

gates.requirement: Client cannot reach computers; outbound-only relay works under faults and load
gates.evidence: Separate Docker front/back networks verify client isolation and Computer-initiated WSS. Bounded native load/fault evidence and post-ACK lost-reply/restart nonreplay are recorded in artifacts/native-load-fault-results.json; production SLO soak and the full fault matrix remain open.

gates.requirement: Versioned OpenAPI, tunnel schemas and shared native conformance fixtures
gates.evidence: Actual registration matches143 Hub and66 authority methods. All published operations carry explicit success/document/stream/upgrade metadata:99 Hub,48 authority,8 internal and110 relay entries (intentional overlap). Native Pi validated97 responses/74 operations/3 SSE. Administrative conformance checked73 observations/37 HTTP leaves/all24 dispatcher operations with161 standalone published-schema validations. All8 generated artifacts match the Docker output. Physical-platform and vendor extension coverage remain separately scoped.

gates.requirement: Runtime identities must never attach old permissions or recovery state to a new instance
gates.evidence: Native brokers retain UUID identities through restart, log binding and resume; legacy PID-only relay targets are rejected. Detached PTY sessions survive Computer restart and two sessions in the same cwd bind only their own producer logs.

gates.requirement: iOS/Android and OAR interfaces and adoption gates specified
gates.evidence: iOS/Android and optional OAR scope awaits the user decision; current Node 22 and explicit local-trust behavior govern the accepted Linux scope.

gates.requirement: Owner grants delegated read/write access to the Computer-configured workspace; membership loss removes files independently of transcript retention
gates.evidence: Native TypeScript secure pinned file-descriptor access, CAS, symlink/hardlink and root boundaries verified in Docker; owner-issued workspace read/write grants and immediate revocation checked through the browser. Linux accepted; macOS secure adapter pending.

gates.requirement: Owner invitations addressed to email, verified phone or exact provider identity without requiring linked email
gates.evidence: tests/invitations.test.ts; independent-hub public API checks; mobile Manage access and Accept invitation browser flows with phone and tenant-specific Feishu identities; copied invitation details. Live provider delivery is a separate gate.

gates.requirement: Selective viewer/operator access to concrete agents independently of computer membership, with explicit revocation and no new-agent creation
gates.evidence: tests/agent-sharing.test.ts; independent-hub API verifies private/future agent exclusion, owner-only sharing, workspace/creation boundaries, queued dispatch and notification authorization, stream downgrade and closure. Two-account mobile browser shares, sends, downgrades/revokes via actual Agent access screen.

gates.requirement: Self-contained v2 with TypeScript native PTY/runtime and tests, no Python or original package dependency, explicit component boundaries
gates.evidence: Final frozen production build, all235 registered TypeScript tests and46 generic browser checks; specialized installed-CLI/live/accessibility suites remain separately scoped. Boundary guard passes with no Python or legacy application dependency. Linux accepted; secure macOS support remains unsupported.
